trustedProducers.installer: Exact root platform installer creates encrypted source automatically through existing systemd-creds provider; never a manual owner step or plaintext-key environment variable.
trustedProducers.managerObserver: Local system bus root-owned socket/root peer; pin org.freedesktop.systemd1 unique owner, verify root UID and PID1, use that unique owner for every query; unit ID and active invocation MainPID/start-time are actual manager observations.
trustedProducers.registryWriter: Restricted installer/service writer binds immutable key ID/generation/fingerprint/profile/source receipt. Public/handler/model channels cannot publish key registry or invocation receipts. Real ACL installation remains mandatory fixture.
trustedProducers.invocationConfirmation: After restart exact service, actual manager invocation plus key bytes fingerprint confirms desired generation. Old connections retire only after readiness/dependent-smoke confirmation under §50.30. Main process alone reads credential; generated handler never receives directory.

sourceToInvocation: actual key fingerprint/profile equals locked server key record
immutable receipt references installed source generation

retainedHistory.rule: Retain encrypted immutable source versions needed by existing immutable protected rows under their exact key IDs; current source replacement does not erase historical availability. Materialize retained versions exclusively via existing systemd credentials, in a server-authored exact-unit manifest. No plaintext archive or key-ID alias namespace.
retainedHistory.use: Historic decrypt selects retained exact keyId and purpose authorized by server receipt; cannot silently use current key. Retirement forbids new seal under old key while preserving authorized reads.
retainedHistory.gate: Physical manifest/source archive availability and rotation confirmation are required A/B fixtures, presently ENV_BLOCKED.

globalNonceProducer: Authenticate request and lock canonical acceptance/context
Resolve confirmed exact invocation/key generation, service purpose and immutable object identity
Generate random nonce and seal exact plaintext with canonical actual typed AAD
Insert global reservation and protected generation/Secret row in same database transaction
Run deferred exact-AAD/row constraints before commit
Nonce collision rolls back candidate cipher and transaction; fresh nonce retains same immutable command semantics
Idempotent retained object replay returns original ciphertext/reservation; never reseals
